gitlab.helpInlineComments: Submit formal COMMENT reviews with optional comments on specific changed lines.

gitlab.helpApprove: Allow the project bot to record an approval. That is a separate act from a review, and project rules may still refuse it.
gitlab.helpStatusCheck: Post a status note on the merge request for queued, running, and final results. It won't block merging.
gitlab.botMissing: This project is still being set up. Reviews and run notes are posted by the agent's own bot account, so finish connecting the project first.

gitea.title: PR review
gitea.helpInlineComments: Submit formal COMMENT reviews with optional comments on specific changed lines. Gitea takes one comment per line, never a range.
gitea.helpRequestChanges: Allow formal REQUEST_CHANGES reviews. Gitea records them with no further precondition.
gitea.helpApprove: Allow the bot to record an approval in the same review. Gitea refuses one on a pull request the bot opened itself.
gitea.helpStatusCheck: Post a commit status on the pull request head for queued, running, and final results. It won't block merging unless configured as a required check.
gitea.repositoryMissing: This repository is still being set up. Reviews and commit statuses are written through the organization's Gitea bot, so finish adding the repository first.

azureDevOps.title: PR review
azureDevOps.helpInlineComments: Post the review as comment threads, with comments on specific changed lines or ranges.
azureDevOps.helpRequestChanges: Allow a “Waiting for author” vote. Agents that share the connection share one vote, so the latest review sets it.
azureDevOps.helpApprove: Allow an approving vote. Whether it counts toward a branch policy is up to that policy.
azureDevOps.helpStatusCheck: Post a pull request status for queued, running, and final results. It blocks completion only if an administrator adds a status policy for it.

policy.title: Usage policy
policy.readOnly: Only the owner can change this
policy.accessHint: Only one agent controls the desktop at a time. Others wait in line first-come, first-served. Screenshots and viewers don’t need to wait.
policy.modeHint: View only allows screenshots. View and control also allows clicking and typing.
policy.firstInputHint: An agent's first click or keystroke in a session waits for approval from someone with access to this computer.
policy.adminPromptsHint: Who handles Windows administrator prompts while an agent controls this computer. Changing this from the computer’s tray menu updates the same setting.
policy.commandLineHint: Running commands and accessing files uses far fewer tokens than screenshots. They run as the signed-in user without taking desktop control, and stop when you pause or stop agents.
policy.shellHint: Whether agents can run shell commands here. Ask requires approval from someone with access to this computer before running each command.
policy.filesHint: Whether agents can read or edit files here. The first write in a session asks for approval, just like the first input.
policy.fileRootsHint: One absolute path per line, such as ~/work. Leave blank to allow the home directory. Shell commands aren’t restricted to these paths.
policy.shellNoIsolation: This desktop has no isolation. Any agent allowed to run commands can do anything this account can, including accessing its keys and signed-in browsers.
policy.commandLineUnsupported: This computer’s daemon doesn’t support command-line access yet. Currently supported on Linux only.
policy.idleHint: Releases control after this long without input (10 to 3600).
policy.maxHint: Maximum time a single session can hold control (60 to 86400).
policy.waitHint: How long an agent waits in line when another agent has control before timing out (0 to 600).
policy.retentionHint: Enter 0 to disable storage, or leave blank to use the deployment default.
policy.driverToolsHint: Also offer agents the driver's own window-level tools. Off by default.
policy.peerToPeerHint: Stream video directly between browser and desktop across networks. This exposes the desktop’s public IP address to viewers. On by default only for self-hosted computers visible to the owner alone.
policy.shareLoginsHint: On Linux, each agent gets its own desktop. When enabled, its browser copies Chromium logins from this computer and other agent desktops. When off, each desktop uses an isolated browser profile.

problem.idleRange: Idle release must be a whole number from 10 to 3600.
problem.maxRange: Longest control must be a whole number from 60 to 86400.
problem.idleAboveMax: Idle release can't be longer than the longest control.
problem.waitRange: Wait in line must be a whole number from 0 to 600.
problem.retentionRange: Screenshot days must be a whole number from 0 to 3650, or blank.
problem.rootsInvalid: Allowed paths must be absolute, one per line, at most 32.
